'''''Cynoglossum cheirifolium''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] belonging to the family [[Boraginaceae]]. It is an herbaceous [[biennial plant|biennial]] native to the western and central [[Mediterranean Basin]], including [[Portugal]], [[Spain]], [[France]], the [[Italian Peninsula]], [[Sardinia]], [[Sicily]], and [[Greece]] in southern Europe, and [[Morocco]], [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]], and [[Libya]] in North Africa .<ref name=powo/>

Two subspecies are accepted:<ref name = powo/>
*'''''Cynoglossum cheirifolium'' subsp. ''cheirifolium''''' (synonyms ''Cynoglossum argenteum'' {{small|Lam.}}, ''C. clavatum'' {{small|Viv.}}, ''C. decipiens'' {{small|Lojac.}}, and ''C. lineatum'' {{small|Risso ex Ces., Pass. & Gibert}}) – Portugal, Spain, France, Italy, Sardinia, Sicily, and Greece
*'''''Cynoglossum cheirifolium'' subsp. ''heterocarpum''''' {{small|(Kunze) Maire}} (synonyms ''Cynoglossum heterocarpum'' {{small|(Kunze) Willk.}}, ''C. arundanum'' {{small|Coss.}}, and ''C. controversum'' {{small|Sennen}}) – Spain, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, and Libya
